title: User Registration and Profile Management
description: Verify successful user registration and profile management with valid data.
testDescription: A new user registers with valid details and manages their profile.
prerequisites: No existing account with the same email.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to registration page.
2. Enter valid user details.
3. Submit the registration form.
4. Log in with new credentials.
5. Update profile information.
expectedResult: User account is created, a confirmation email is sent, and profile updates are saved.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis for age and contact number fields

title: Course Enrollment and Management
description: Ensure users can enroll in courses and manage their enrollments.
testDescription: A user enrolls in a course and manages their enrollment status.
prerequisites: User is logged in and has a valid profile.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to course catalog.
2. Select a course.
3. Enroll in the course.
4. View enrolled courses.
5. Withdraw from the course.
expectedResult: User successfully enrolls and withdraws from courses, with status updates reflected accurately.
additionalFields: State Transition testing for enrollment status

title: Assignment Submission and Grading
description: Validate the process of assignment submission and grading.
testDescription: A student submits an assignment and receives a grade.
prerequisites: Student is enrolled in a course with assignments.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to course assignments.
2. Select an assignment.
3. Submit the assignment.
4. Instructor grades the assignment.
5. Student views the grade.
expectedResult: Assignment is submitted successfully, graded by the instructor, and grade is visible to the student.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis for grade input

title: User Role and Permission Management
description: Test role-based access and permissions for different user roles.
testDescription: Verify access control for different user roles.
prerequisites: Multiple user roles exist with defined permissions.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as an admin.
2. Assign roles to users.
3. Log in as a student.
4. Attempt to access admin features.
5. Log in as an instructor and access grading features.
expectedResult: Users can only access features permitted by their roles.
additionalFields: Decision Table testing for role-based access

title: Reporting and Analytics Dashboard
description: Verify the functionality of the reporting and analytics dashboard.
testDescription: Generate and view reports on user activity and course performance.
prerequisites: User has access to the analytics dashboard.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as an admin.
2. Navigate to the analytics dashboard.
3. Generate a report on course enrollments.
4. View detailed analytics on user activity.
expectedResult: Reports are generated accurately and display comprehensive analytics.

title: Notification and Alert System
description: Verify the notification and alert system for course updates and deadlines.
testDescription: Ensure users receive timely notifications and alerts for course updates and assignment deadlines.
prerequisites: User is enrolled in a course with upcoming deadlines.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as a student.
2. Navigate to the course dashboard.
3. Check for notifications related to upcoming assignments.
4. Verify alert settings for deadlines.
5. Simulate a course update and check for notifications.
expectedResult: Users receive notifications and alerts for course updates and deadlines as per their settings.
additionalFields: Proper handling of notifications and alerts

title: UI Interactions Across All Screens
description: Test the user interface interactions across all screens and forms.
testDescription: Ensure all UI elements are functional and accessible across different screens.
prerequisites: User is logged in and has access to all relevant screens.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate through all available screens and forms.
2. Interact with UI elements like buttons, dropdowns, and text fields.
3. Verify responsiveness and accessibility.
4. Check for consistent UI design and layout.
expectedResult: All UI elements are functional, accessible, and consistent across screens.

title: Data Validation for Student Information
description: Validate the integrity and accuracy of student information data.
testDescription: Ensure student information is correctly validated and stored.
prerequisites: Student profile exists with editable fields.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as a student.
2. Navigate to the profile management page.
3. Edit student information fields.
4. Submit changes and verify data integrity.
5. Attempt to input invalid data and check validation messages.
expectedResult: Student information is validated and stored accurately, with appropriate error messages for invalid data.
additionalFields: Data validation for student information fields

title: Integration with External Payment Gateway
description: Test the integration with external payment gateways for course payments.
testDescription: Ensure seamless integration and transaction processing with payment gateways.
prerequisites: User is enrolled in a paid course.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the payment page.
2. Select a payment method.
3. Complete the payment process through the external gateway.
4. Verify transaction success and course enrollment status.
expectedResult: Payments are processed successfully, and course enrollment status is updated accordingly.

title: State Transition for Course Enrollment
description: Validate state transitions during the course enrollment process.
testDescription: Ensure correct state transitions from enrollment to completion.
prerequisites: User is logged in and has access to course enrollment.
stepsToPerform:
1. Enroll in a course.
2. Complete course requirements.
3. Verify state transition from 'Enrolled' to 'Completed'.
4. Check for accurate updates in user profile and course status.
expectedResult: State transitions occur correctly, reflecting accurate course status updates.
additionalFields: State Transition testing for enrollment status

title: Multi-Role User Notification Preferences
description: Verify that users with multiple roles can set and receive notifications according to each role.
testDescription: A user with both student and instructor roles sets different notification preferences for each role.
prerequisites: User has both student and instructor roles assigned.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as a user with multiple roles.
2. Navigate to notification settings.
3. Set preferences for student role.
4. Set different preferences for instructor role.
5. Trigger notifications for both roles.
expectedResult: User receives notifications according to the preferences set for each role.
additionalFields: Decision Table testing for role-based notification settings

title: Cross-Platform UI Consistency
description: Ensure UI consistency and functionality across different devices and screen sizes.
testDescription: Verify that the application UI is consistent and functional on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
prerequisites: Access to devices with different screen sizes.
stepsToPerform:
1. Access the application on a desktop.
2. Navigate through various screens.
3. Repeat steps on a tablet.
4. Repeat steps on a mobile device.
5. Compare UI elements and functionality across devices.
expectedResult: UI elements are consistent and functional across all devices.

title: Data Integrity During Course Withdrawal
description: Validate data integrity when a user withdraws from a course.
testDescription: Ensure that all related data is correctly updated when a user withdraws from a course.
prerequisites: User is enrolled in a course.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as the enrolled user.
2. Navigate to the enrolled courses section.
3. Withdraw from a course.
4. Verify updates in user profile, course status, and analytics.
expectedResult: All related data is updated correctly upon course withdrawal.
additionalFields: Data validation for course withdrawal process

title: Grade Calculation Accuracy
description: Ensure accurate calculation of grades based on assignment scores and weightage.
testDescription: Verify that grades are calculated accurately according to the defined grading scheme.
prerequisites: Course with defined grading scheme and assignments.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as an instructor.
2. Enter scores for assignments.
3. Verify calculated grades for students.
4. Compare with manual calculations.
expectedResult: Grades are calculated accurately as per the grading scheme.
additionalFields: Boundary Value Analysis for grade calculation

title: External System Integration for Learning Management
description: Test integration with external learning management systems for course content synchronization.
testDescription: Ensure seamless synchronization of course content with external learning management systems.
prerequisites: Access to an external learning management system.
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in as an admin.
2. Set up integration with an external LMS.
3. Synchronize course content.
4. Verify content accuracy and completeness.
expectedResult: Course content is synchronized accurately with the external LMS.
